King, 2 Twins (sleeps 4 total)

Perfectly nestled just one block from the beach and directly across from Seaside’s West Side Pool, Honahlea offers the ultimate blend of privacy, charm, and convenience for your next beach getaway. This thoughtfully designed guest cottage — part of the larger Midsummer Night’s Dream property — invites you to experience the magic of Seaside, Florida, in comfort and style.

Upon arrival, guests are guided along a peaceful, sandy footpath that winds through native greenery, leading to the cottage’s private entrance. A classic white picket fence surrounds the home’s beautifully landscaped yard, while the inviting front porch provides the perfect welcome. Complete with cooling outdoor fans and plush chaise lounges, this open-air space offers a serene setting to enjoy morning coffee, a quiet afternoon read, or evening cocktails beneath the stars.

Step inside into the main level. The primary bedroom is located on the main floor and features a king-size bed, soft coastal décor, and an ensuite bathroom with a luxurious soaking tub — ideal for relaxing after a day in the sun. The open-concept living and dining area is filled with natural light and offers ample space for gathering and unwinding, as well as a flatscreen TV. Highlights include a fully equipped kitchen with everything needed to prepare meals at home and a dining nook for two. Just off the main living area, a charming bonus loft is accessible by a ship’s ladder. This tucked-away space, best suited for children or young adults, includes twin futon beds.

Whether you’re spending your days by the pool, walking to Seaside’s iconic town center, or relaxing on the sugar-white sands just minutes from your door, Honahlea is your perfect home base. The cottage's prime location offers easy access to Seaside's many amenities — including boutique shopping, award-winning dining, live music, and vibrant community events — all while providing a peaceful, private retreat.

* There is active construction adjacent to the property. Guests should anticipate daytime noise and construction-related activity. We are unable to control or predict daily work schedules.

* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2-night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.

* Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided
* Only 1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage; a golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit
* No pets allowed

Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Seaside, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Snorkeling and windsurfing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling and ecotours nearby.
